other_conditions: The beneficiary must be engaged in building or other construction work
The beneficiary must be registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)
The beneficiary must have an active membership of the Board
The beneficiary must be hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or any disease
benefits_summary: ₹200 per day for the first 5 days and ₹20 per additional day (minimum ₹1,000), with up to ₹5,000 assistance for disability based on percentage of disability.
